title: Kilikiai Pylai
description: The Cilician Gates, a pass through the Taurus Mountains connecting Cilicia to the Anatolian Plateau, by way of the gorge of the Gökoluk River.

properties.description: Cilician Gates location (now filled by modern highway) as determined by: 1) still extant inscription just N of tightest point of pass, SRTM (Shuttle Radar Topography Mission) data (GIS processed), and GPS track of personal autopsy, Dec 2024; Added reference to inscription that is still extant.
